arxiv-2102-08829.title: Magnonics in collinear magnetic insulating systems
arxiv-2102-08829.creator: B. Flebus
arxiv-2102-08829.description: Abstract In the last decades, collinear magnetic insulating systems have emerged as promising energy-saving information carriers. Their elementary collective spin excitations, i.e., magnons, can propagate for long distances bypassing the Joule heating effects that arise from electron scattering in metal-based devices.

arxiv-2205-06452.title: Proving Unsolvability of Set Agreement Task with Epistemic μ \mu -Calculus
arxiv-2205-06452.creator: Susumu Nishimura
arxiv-2205-06452.description: Abstract This paper shows, in the framework of the logical method [ 8 , 21 ] , the unsolvability of k k -set agreement task by devising a suitable formula of epistemic logic. The unsolvability of k k -set agreement task is a well-known fact, which is a direct consequence of Sperner’s lemma, a classic result from combinatorial topology.

arxiv-2401-09932.title: Real-time and On-site Aerodynamics using Stereoscopic PIV and Deep Optical Flow Learning
arxiv-2401-09932.creator: Mohamed Elrefaie, Steffen Hüttig, Mariia Gladkova, Timo Gericke, Daniel Cremers, and Christian Breitsamter
arxiv-2401-09932.description: Abstract We introduce Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms for Stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (RAFT-StereoPIV). Our approach leverages deep optical flow learning to analyze time-resolved and double-frame particle images from on-site measurements, particularly from the ’Ring of Fire,’ as well as from wind tunnel measurements for real-time aerodynamic analysis.

arxiv-2402-07159.title: Central-surface-densities correlation in general MOND theories
arxiv-2402-07159.creator: Mordehai Milgrom
arxiv-2402-07159.description: Abstract It is shown that the foundational axioms of MOND alone predict a strong correlation between a bulk measure of the baryonic surface density, Σ B \Sigma_{\scriptscriptstyle B} , and the corresponding dynamical one, Σ D \Sigma_{\scriptscriptstyle D} , of an isolated, self-gravitating object, such as a galaxy.

arxiv-2403-00069.title: Learning interacting fermionic Hamiltonians at the Heisenberg limit
arxiv-2403-00069.creator: Arjun Mirani, Patrick Hayden
arxiv-2403-00069.description: Abstract Efficiently learning an unknown Hamiltonian given access to its dynamics is a problem of interest for quantum metrology, many-body physics and machine learning. A fundamental question is whether learning can be performed at the Heisenberg limit, where the Hamiltonian evolution time scales inversely with the error, ε \varepsilon , in the reconstructed parameters.

pmc-11692303.title: COMPARING STROKE MORTALITY TRENDS IN RURAL AND URBAN AREAS DURING AND BEFORE THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC
pmc-11692303.creator: Vivian Lin, Sasha DiVall, Mengyuan Cheng, Nasim Ferdows
pmc-11692303.description: COVID-19 has undeniably disrupted healthcare services, with many individuals advised to avoid hospital visits unless necessary. However, timely treatment following a stroke is critical to minimize damage or fatality, raising concerns about how these disruptions may have affected stroke outcomes. This study explores the association between COVID-19 and stroke mortality rates across different ruralities across a three-year period (2018-2020).

pmc-11862698.title: Significant beneficial effects of 12-weeks add-on yoga therapy on antipsychotic-stabilized schizophrenia patients through epigenetic modulation: novel findings from a randomized controlled study
pmc-11862698.creator: M Debnath, T Mullapudi, R Govindaraj, P Raj, S Varambally
pmc-11862698.description: IntroductionComplementary and alternative therapy, especially yoga, is emerging as an important treatment modality for various complex disorders. Yoga therapy has reportedly been demonstrated to exhibit clinical benefits in schizophrenia. However, the modulatory effects of yoga therapy on the pathobiological pathways of schizophrenia are inadequately explored. Immune dysregulation is a widely recognized etiopathological construct of schizophrenia.

pmc-13432086.creator: Yasmine El Ouafa, Inasse Mourabiti, Nabiha El Abdi, Monsif Fadi, Houda Benrahma, Nouama Bouanani
pmc-13432086.description: BackgroundIron-deficiency anemia (IDA) is a major clinical burden, particularly when caused by gastrointestinal or gynecological blood loss and mucosal malabsorption. Oral iron supplementation, while widely accessible, is frequently limited by poor gastrointestinal tolerability and inadequate absorption. Intravenous (IV) iron offers a more direct route to iron repletion, yet real-world comparative data from resource-limited settings remain scarce.

uslaw-usc-t25-s2503.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 27 (Tribally Controlled School Grants). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general The grant provided under this chapter to an Indian tribe or tribal organization for any fiscal year shall consist of— (1) the total amount of funds allocated for such fiscal year under sections 1127 and 1128 of the Education Amendments of 1978.
